from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Any

from PIL import Image
import pytest

from llm_router import Model, Provider
from llm_router._internal.capabilities.content import normalize_content
from llm_router._internal.capabilities.tools import ToolRegistry
from llm_router._internal.providers.base import (
    ProviderCredential,
    ProviderRequest,
)
from llm_router._internal.providers.qwenchat import QwenChatAdapter

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


def sample_tool(location: str) -> str:
    """Return weather information for a given location."""
    return f"weather in {location}"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_QWENCHAT_ADAPTER_BOUNDARY[revision==1]")
async def test_qwenchat_abuild_payload_returns_payload_with_merged_fields() -> None:
    uploaded_ref = "upload_ref_abc123"

    async def stub_uploader(media: Any) -> str:
        assert media is not None
        return uploaded_ref

    registry = ToolRegistry()
    registry.register(sample_tool)

    image = Image.new("RGB", (10, 10), color="white")
    content = normalize_content(["Analyze image:", image])

    request = ProviderRequest(
        provider=Provider.QWENCHAT,
        model=Model.QWEN_MAX,
        provider_model="qwen-max",
        messages=[content],
        credential=ProviderCredential(value="test-credential-value"),
        temperature=0.7,
        seed=42,
        tool_registry=registry,
        kwargs={"custom_option": "custom_value"},
    )

    adapter = QwenChatAdapter(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8000")
    payload = await adapter.abuild_payload(request, uploader=stub_uploader)

    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    assert payload["model"] == "qwen-max"
    assert payload["stream"] is False
    assert uploaded_ref in json.dumps(payload["messages"])
    assert payload["temperature"] == 0.7
    assert payload["seed"] == 42
    assert len(payload["tools"]) == 1
    assert payload["custom_option"] == "custom_value"
